latest_session.title: 2026-09-01 (recursive-logit support pruning)
latest_session.goal: Permit recursive-logit active-set restriction without changing surviving action utilities.
latest_session.outcome: Full library suite passes 148 tests. The solver now supports exact restriction of an existing recursive-logit model: removed alternatives lose their mass, while surviving `tau log q` utilities remain unchanged.
latest_session.next_steps: Sparse/cached linear systems remain the main library performance task. A global pruning-loss certificate requires path-length or occupancy information; a one-step local mass bound is insufficient.
files_touched: `src/jr_optlib/optimization/recursive_logit.py` -- explicit reference weights may now form subprobability rows after pruning; default unpruned rows remain normalized.
`tests/test_recursive_logit.py` -- added a pruning differential proving that fixed surviving weights raise the logsum cost, whereas renormalization would change the model.
